problems.explain: The pole is opposite the sun's angle at the shadow's tip, and the shadow is adjacent: tan θ = 48/49. θ = tan⁻¹(48/49) ≈ 44.4093°, 44° to the nearest degree. (tan⁻¹(49/48) is the angle at the top of the pole.) So 44°.
